title: MegaMari - Psycho Anxiety 💉 ~ Reisen Udongein Inaba's Stage (Remix)
description:
My, red eyes again....
Maybe I haven't had enough sleep.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ- Reisen Udongein Inaba, 2009

Did an arrangement of Reisen Udongein Inaba's Stage from Twilight Frontier's MegaMari. After 3 years of non-stop Mega Man & Touhou arrangements, I thought it'd be about time to pull this one out.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," Yoshi, P-Switch, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. B Minor w/ major detune (Remix Pitch - Listening-Only)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. C Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. C# Minor (Custom Pitch 1)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. B Minor (Custom Pitch 2)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ5. D Minor (Custom Pitch 3)
